headline_finding_fully_closed.text: Only AUTHORITATIVE_VERIFIED or governed MANUAL_VERIFIED revisions with complete applicable terms may be adjustment-active.
headline_finding_fully_closed.history: This is the rule the reference-population audit used to demonstrate the whole problem: it is enforced by one line at AdjustmentFactorSetService::authoritativeEventsThrough(), and widening that filter to admit PROVIDER_REPORTED passed all 1946 tests. Because the rule was REFERENCE_ONLY, no traceability row claimed the invariant either.
headline_finding_fully_closed.status_now: Its MD-B12 twin MD-S083-R0032 was bound in MD-B12-A002 with a new behavioural guard. This attempt binds the MD-B11 copy to the same guard. Both copies of the invariant are now claimed and protected.

the_gap_that_turned_out_not_to_be_one.expectation: Reported as the two genuinely unguarded rules: GAP_BEYOND_EXCHANGE_BAND appeared in zero tests and GAP_AMBIGUOUS only as a fixture value.
the_gap_that_turned_out_not_to_be_one.what_the_check_found: continuity_check_status, observed_gap_pct, GAP_BEYOND_EXCHANGE_BAND and GAP_AMBIGUOUS appear in zero files under app, config and routes. They exist only in the migration that declares the column diagnostic only, the SQLite test mirror, and three test files.
the_gap_that_turned_out_not_to_be_one.conclusion: Both are prohibitions satisfied by construction: the diagnostic cannot justify an adjustment or clear an ambiguity because no application code reads it at all. The correct proof is a structural invariant pinning that, not a behavioural branch that does not exist.

deviation_found_in_existing_records.what: IMPLEMENTATION_RESIDUE_AND_CONFORMANCE_STANDARD.md enumerates exactly five residue states. Issued records across the package use scope-suffixed variants that are not among them.
deviation_found_in_existing_records.measured: 11 occurrences of CONFORMANT_NO_HARMFUL_RESIDUE_FOUND_IN_THE_B*, 5 of ..._IN_A*, 2 of CONFORMANT_WITH_DECLARED_HISTORICAL_GAP, 2 of CONFORMANT_NO_HARMFUL_EXECUTABLE_RESIDUE_FOUND, against 31 uses of the enumerated token.
deviation_found_in_existing_records.my_own_contribution: 9 of the suffixed occurrences were written earlier in this same work unit, for MD-B07-A002, MD-B08-A002, MD-B09-A003 and MD-B12-A002. This attempt uses the enumerated token; the earlier records are immutable and are not edited.
deviation_found_in_existing_records.status: Reported, not remediated here. The verdicts are readable and their meaning is not in doubt, but a state machine whose values are invented per attempt cannot be checked mechanically. No gate currently validates the residue vocabulary.
